verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-serve export of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history and suppression list in an open format. The only related material is general API read access (pulling data, paginated events), which is a developer building block for constructing an export, not the export capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
